accuracy.definition: Proportion of correct predictions among total predictions
accuracy.when_to_use: Good for balanced datasets, can be misleading with imbalanced classes

precision_macro.formula: Average of precision for each class
precision_macro.when_to_use: When all classes are equally important

precision_weighted.definition: Weighted average precision by class frequency
precision_weighted.formula: Weighted average of precision for each class
precision_weighted.when_to_use: When classes have different importance based on frequency

recall_macro.formula: Average of recall for each class
recall_macro.when_to_use: When detecting all positive cases is important

f1_macro.definition: Harmonic mean of precision and recall (macro average)

roc_auc.definition: Area Under the ROC Curve - measures classifier performance
roc_auc.formula: Area under the curve plotting TPR vs FPR
roc_auc.when_to_use: Binary classification, especially with balanced classes
